I am citing 26.7.2 and leaving it to the gate to decide whether I may handle or close the complaint. If the gate blocks it, that block is the recorded hand-over to a human agent. The draft keeps the complaint open and makes no promise to close it.

args.body: Thank you for your message. Your complaint remains open and has not been closed. Because this is a Consumer Complaint, the decision on it is not mine to make or to close in this chat. I am passing it to a human colleague who will review it and respond to you. I will not close it on my own.
